pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with distinct, sharp edges and minimal pixel blurring at boundaries. Patches on the cervical region are smaller and more densely packed than those on the thoracic/lumbar flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting network of light cream pathways. Predominantly tri-nodal junction points. Pathway width is generally uniform across the flank, with slight tapering observed at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane exhibits a consistent, high-frequency jagged silhouette with a serrated 1D profile against the background. Amplitude of serrations is uniform throughout the visible dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, circular hyper-pigmented spot is present on the mid-lower flank. A vertical cutaneous crease is visible extending through the central lateral flank.
